prose: Maryn Green of the Indie Birth Association joins InnerVerse to discuss her private midwifery practice and experience as a guide to sacred birth. We talk about the intuitive knowledge within the female body, miscarriage support, informed medical choice, and the mystical non-sedated birth.
ext: We discuss the spiritual and biological significance of the placenta, the divine twin symbolism, issues with state-licensed midwifery and why Maryn gave hers back, Private Member Associations, and mothering the mother.
